settings.question: Is breakage the same as hair fall?
settings.answer: No. Breakage is hair snapping along the length. Hair fall is shedding at the root. This mask is a lengths treatment and does not address every cause of hair loss.

settings.question: Is this a salon keratin straightening treatment?
settings.answer: No. It is a rinse-off conditioning mask. It does not chemically straighten or permanently reconstruct hair.

settings.question: Can it permanently repair split ends?
settings.answer: No. It can improve how hair looks and feels, but it does not permanently restore split ends.
